card.name: Time or population nouns ending a quantity
card.fires_on: Nouns that complete a quantity or life-related phrase, such as day, hours, daily, diet, span and people, especially after a number or 'per'/'a'. Seen in nutrition, intake and population text.

modes.label: Per-day amounts
modes.description: The word day, daily or hours finishing an amount or duration after a number.
modes.example: Recommended dietary allowances (RDAs) are 2.4 micrograms per<< day>> for adults and adolescents

modes.label: Diet and life nouns
modes.description: Nouns like diet, requirements, span or people in general statements about human nutrition or lifespan.
modes.example: Humans must include adequate amounts of 9 amino acids in their<< diet>>.

card.plain: It lights up on the last word of an amount or human-life phrase, like 'per day' or 'in their diet'.
